psychological_meaning: Monza, a deep and vibrant red, is strongly associated with passion, energy, and excitement. It evokes feelings of intensity, courage, and determination. This color can also symbolize love, danger, and importance, depending on the context. Its bold nature makes it a powerful and attention-grabbing choice.

real_world_examples.title: Ferrari
real_world_examples.description: The iconic red color of Ferrari cars symbolizes speed, luxury, and Italian passion.

real_world_examples.title: Stop Signs
real_world_examples.description: The use of red in stop signs universally signifies danger and the need to halt.

how_to_pair: Pair with white for a clean, modern look.
Combine with black for a sophisticated and powerful statement.
Use with gold accents for a touch of luxury.
Balance with cooler blues and greens to create contrast.
